prompts.text: What's a local story people tell differently depending on who you ask?
Tell me about hearing an older neighbour describe how your area used to look.
A funny story about a local character or a surprising tale about a familiar building?
A story becomes part of neighbourhood history when enough people keep retelling it.
You're collecting light-hearted stories for a community newsletter. What would you ask people to share?
Which local story always seems to come up when visitors ask questions?
The funniest community stories often involve ordinary events nobody planned to remember.
Describe a time a casual chat revealed a story about a place you pass every day.
Someone claims to know the true origin of a neighbourhood nickname. What would you ask them?
What's a story about your hometown you'd like to hear from someone who was there?
What's a handmade item you often see people using in everyday life where you live?
Tell me about watching someone repair an object using a skill you didn't know existed.
A handwoven basket or a piece of pottery made for daily use?
Small workshops often have a familiar rhythm that regular visitors learn to recognise.
You're visiting a local maker's stall with a friend. What would you ask about before choosing something?
Which everyday object do you think looks better when somebody makes it by hand?
A useful handmade object deserves as much appreciation as a decorative one.
Describe learning why a maker preferred one simple tool over a newer alternative.
A neighbour offers to teach you one practical skill they learnt growing up. What would you choose?
What's a small handmade gift people in your community enjoy giving?
Which little custom in your area do you hope people will still practise years from now?
Tell me about a simple habit you picked up from another household and kept.
You're asked to teach a newcomer one cheerful local custom in five minutes. Which would you choose?
